title: learn-applied
description: An entry of the decision log of learning, one per line, byte format kept (feature 106, T010; the field list is the table 'Decision log entry' of specs/106-learning/data-model.md, and the specification stands where the two differ). As-is id the same; entries of `specstride.learn.applied/1` are read and never match a shape. The bytes of the log are hashed by the binding of the launch contract (F106-FR-027), so the byte format is part of this record: one JSON object per line, `, ` between members, `: ` after a name, non-ASCII as `\uXXXX` in lower case, one line feed at the end.
x-closed-sets: Row 188 (actions) and row 187 (adjustable knobs) of annex X §X.6, read from @specstride/contracts and not restated here as data.

schema.description: Schema id; an entry of `specstride.learn.applied/1` is read too

action.description: The action of the entry (closed set 188). An entry from before the action existed carries none and is a decision

run_id.description: A decision run id: `learn-` and twelve hexadecimal characters; an `evaluate` entry carries the id of the run it evaluated

knob.description: A member of the adjustable-knob allowlist (closed set 187)

phase.description: The phase the decision applies to

shape.description: The phase shape the decision was learned under; absent or null for the entries recorded before shapes existed, which never match a shape

value.description: The value the entry records; a revert records the restored value

previous.description: The value that was in force before the entry

samples.description: The work-seconds samples behind an apply; null on a revert

source_runs.description: The runs the decision was learned from; never in its own applied arm

metric.description: The metric the value was derived from, e.g. `work_sec_p90`

applied_at.description: UTC to the second; the last member of every entry

baseline.description: Of an apply entry: `backend`, `shape`, `runs`, `cost` and `wall` (lists of [run, value]) and `guardrails`

force.description: Present only when the value was applied over a quarantine

forced_over.description: The run id of the automatic revert that quarantined the value; present only with `force`

auto.description: Present only on an automatic revert, immediately after `action`

reverts_run_id.description: Of a revert: the run id of the apply it undoes

quarantined_value.description: Of an automatic revert: the value it quarantined

backend.description: Of an automatic revert: the harness label the revert was decided under

reverted_ts.description: Of an automatic revert: when it was decided

evaluated_from.description: Of an automatic revert: the run whose evaluation breached

guardrail.description: Of an automatic revert: the guardrail names joined by commas

action_taken.description: Of an evaluate entry, where an action was taken (closed set 191)

label.description: Of an evaluate entry: the combined label (closed set 190)

evaluated_at.description: Of an evaluate entry: UTC to the second
